title: Embedding configuration
content: NeuroFlow generates embeddings during ingestion only when an embedding provider is configured. The current backend configures an OpenAI provider when LLM_API_KEY is present. If no provider is configured, non-image documents can still be extracted and chunked, but their chunks have no vector embeddings. The ingestion status response reports embedding_count so an operator can confirm how many chunks received vectors. Image ingestion requires a configured vision provider. Dense retrieval also requires an embedding provider; sparse keyword retrieval can still return candidates without one.
